description: The least a US cleaning business can charge per cleaner-hour and for a standard 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom clean without losing money, from the median cleaner wage in that state (Bureau of Labor Statistics) plus payroll costs, supplies, overhead and profit. Leave the state out for the national figures.
